description: This file defines a class RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter used for splitting text into chunks recursively based on multiple separators, primarily for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ingestion tasks.

classes.name: RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter
classes.description: Implements recursive splitting of text into chunks using multiple separators, with configurable chunk size, overlap, and recursion depth.

methods.name: List[str] split_text(self, text: str)
methods.description: Public method to split text into chunks.

methods.name: List[str] _split_text(self, text: str, separators: List[str], depth: int = 0)
methods.description: Private method that performs recursive splitting based on separators and depth.

methods.name: List[str] _merge_splits(self, splits: List[str], separator: str)
methods.description: Merges smaller splits into larger chunks respecting chunk size and overlap constraints.

methods.name: List[str] _force_split(self, text: str)
methods.description: Forces splitting of text into chunks of chunk size when no suitable separator is found.
